support_decision: Keep BF16 KV as the only supported/default Qwen3.8-27B server route. Pure FP32-scale per-token/head INT8 and tail-four Hadamard-group32 INT8 both pass the measured quality gates through a bounded 32K prompt, but neither creates worst-case 32K memory headroom: chunk-outer BF16 prefill oracles raise tracked peak by 1.023560 GiB and 0.267700 GiB respectively. Pure INT8 eager decode is faster than BF16 graph, but both candidates have a small reproducible prefill regression, and the no-oracle direct tail-four prefill screen produces non-finite logits.

quality_protocol.teacher: same-model BF16 KV with reference-token teacher forcing

memory_at_33024_positions.interpretation: Both layouts reduce retained decode-time ownership, but current chunk-outer prefill holds one full-length BF16 K/V oracle pair per INT8 layer until prefill exits. The oracle bytes exceed the retained savings, so neither layout increases worst-case request headroom.

runtime_screen.workload: 4K prompt / 128 decode / 32786 capacity / one discarded warmup / three measured persistent-session runs / GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1
runtime_screen.interpretation: Pure INT8 eager decode is already 7.46% faster than the supported BF16 graph route, and tail4 graph decode is 2.58% faster. Both prefill sample bands are entirely below BF16 by about 0.33-0.34%, and tracked peak rises by the exact oracle-minus-retained deltas. The phase-sampled HIP value is not a continuous high-water measurement and misses the transient; tracked allocator peak controls this decision.

existing_32k_server_projection.projection_method: Add the byte-exact measured tracked peak delta at the same 33024-position allocation to the prior measured BF16 whole-device peak. These are explicit projections, not fresh whole-device candidate-server measurements.

no_oracle_direct_prefill_screen.candidate: tail4_hadamard_group32 with retained INT8 cache bound directly to the existing Hadamard-group32 streaming prefill kernel
no_oracle_direct_prefill_screen.scope: temporary monkeypatch; mixed_ja_en_translate and mixed_v1 narrow 512/8 screen; no tracked source change
no_oracle_direct_prefill_screen.result: rejected before the first scored candidate row
no_oracle_direct_prefill_screen.failure: FloatingPointError: GGUF resident lm-head logits contain NaN or Inf
no_oracle_direct_prefill_screen.interpretation: The existing direct no-oracle arithmetic is not a quality-safe substitute for exact BF16 prefill. Do not expose it for Qwen3.8.

limitations: The 32K quality row is a bounded mixed_v1 prompt, not the complete eleven-prompt suite.
Quality rows intentionally ran pure INT8 on RX 7900 XTX and tail4 on W7900; both are gfx1100, and timings from quality harnesses are not performance evidence.
Runtime uses repeated token 9707 only for fixed-shape throughput and memory. Quality uses the complete natural/category/heldout suite plus mixed_v1.
No MTP gate was run because neither candidate passed peak-memory and prefill non-regression admission.
Projected candidate server peaks are additive projections from byte-exact tracked deltas, not measured candidate server high-water rows.
next_if_revisited: Preserve exact BF16 prefill while replacing the chunk-outer per-INT8-layer full-length oracle lifetime, most plausibly with a bounded layer-outer/shared-oracle owner and an independently memory-gated hidden plane. Then rerun complete 512/8 and 4K/16, bounded/full 32K, actual server whole-device high water, prefill/decode, and full natural MTP. Do not expose the existing direct INT8 prefill path.
